body.label: Body

readOnly.unsupported: This item contains content this editor cannot edit safely: {{types}}. It is shown read-only so nothing is lost.
readOnly.invalid: This item's content does not match the structure this editor can edit, so its text is shown read-only instead. Nothing is lost: the stored content is unchanged.
readOnly.forbidden: You can read this item but not edit it.
readOnly.trash: This item is in the trash. Restore it to edit it.
readOnly.noText: This item has no text that can be shown.

save.failed: Saving failed. Your text is still here; try again.
save.failedWith: Saving failed: {{detail}} Your text is still here.
save.conflict: Someone else saved this item in the meantime, and the newer version could not be loaded. Your text is still here; copy it before reloading.

panel.title: Settings
panel.description: Status, address, excerpt and terms of this item in {{label}}.

status.heading: Status and publishing
status.author: Author

publish.description: Check what goes out, then choose when.

summary.title: Title
summary.excerptDerived: Taken from the start of the body

publish.unsaved: Your unsaved changes are saved first.
publish.nowHint: Live as soon as you confirm

schedule.past: That time has passed. Pick one in the future.
schedule.invalid: Pick a date and a time.

slug.label: Slug
slug.newHint: Made from the title when you first save; you can change it here.
slug.unknownUntilSave: The address updates when you save.
slug.invalid: No spaces or / ? # % < > " ' \ ` in a slug.

excerpt.label: Excerpt
excerpt.placeholder: Empty: taken from the start of the body
excerpt.hint: Shown in lists, feeds and search results.
excerpt.willDerive: Taken from the body again when you save.

terms.search: Find or type a new one…
terms.emptyCreate: No matching terms. Type a name to create one.

parent.label: Parent
parent.unavailableHint: You may not have access to the current parent. It stays as it is unless you pick another.

danger.heading: Danger zone
danger.hintUndo: You can undo this right after.
danger.hintNoUndo: You won't be able to restore it yourself; an editor can.

conflict.title: This item changed while you were editing
conflict.descriptionAfter: . Your text is safe. Compare the two and choose which one to keep.
conflict.explain: Keep mine saves your version over the newer one. Take theirs opens the newer version; yours stays as an autosave you can restore. Copy my text puts your body text on the clipboard, then takes theirs.
conflict.failed: That did not work. Your text is still here; try again.
conflict.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Your text is still here.
conflict.copied: Your text is on the clipboard
conflict.keptThen: Your version is saved. Run the action again when you are ready.
conflict.same: This item was saved elsewhere with the same content; you are on the latest version now.
conflict.sameThen: This item was saved elsewhere; you are on the latest version now. Try again.

paused.publish: Publishing was paused so nothing goes live by surprise. Publish again once you have chosen.
paused.schedule: Scheduling was paused so nothing goes live by surprise. Schedule again once you have chosen.
paused.submit: Submitting for review was paused. Submit again once you have chosen.
paused.unpublish: Unpublishing was paused. Unpublish again once you have chosen.
paused.revision: The version was not restored. Choose which text to keep, then restore it again if you still want to.

conflict.changed: This item was saved elsewhere; you are on its latest version now.

changedThen.publish: This item was saved elsewhere, so it was not published. You are on its latest version now; publish again when ready.
changedThen.schedule: This item was saved elsewhere, so it was not scheduled. You are on its latest version now; schedule again when ready.
changedThen.submit: This item was saved elsewhere, so it was not submitted. You are on its latest version now; submit again when ready.
changedThen.unpublish: This item was saved elsewhere, so it was not unpublished. You are on its latest version now; try again when ready.
changedThen.revision: This item was saved elsewhere, so the version was not restored. You are on its latest version now; restore again when ready.

restore.safe: They were kept as an autosave. Save to update the item, or discard them.
restore.stale: This item has changed since then. When you save, you will choose which version to keep.
restore.kept: Your version is kept as an autosave.
restore.keptHint: You are looking at the newer saved version. Restore yours to keep working on it.
restore.undoFailed: Could not bring the changes back.
restore.discardFailed: Could not discard the changes. They are still kept; try again.
restore.safeInMemory: They are held on this page until you save; leaving asks first.
restore.keptEdited: Your new edits are not autosaved while your version is kept here. Save them, or discard the kept version to autosave again.
restore.replaceEdits: Restoring your version replaces the edits you made since. Restore anyway?
restore.keptUnstored: Your version could not be kept as an autosave; it is only on this page.
restore.backupHint: They were made over your kept version and never saved. Restore them to keep working, or discard them.
restore.backupFailed: Could not restore the edits from this browser. They are still kept here; try again.

leave.title: Leave with unsaved changes?
leave.description: Your latest changes are not saved to this item yet.
leave.descriptionNew: This item has not been saved yet. If you leave without saving, it is lost.
leave.descriptionAutosaved: Your latest changes are kept as an autosave, but not saved to this item yet.
leave.descriptionKept: Discarding drops only your edits since you took the newer version. Your own version stays kept as an autosave.
leave.descriptionKeptOnlyHere: Your own version (kept when you took the newer one) could not be stored as an autosave and is only on this page. Save and leave, or Discard changes, stores it first.
leave.keptFailed: Your own version still could not be stored, so you stay on this page. Try again, or copy your text first.
leave.uploading_one: An image is still uploading: leaving cancels it.
leave.uploading_other: {{count}} images are still uploading: leaving cancels them.

revisions.entryHint: See what changed and bring back an earlier version
revisions.title: Version history
revisions.description: Every save of this item, newest first. Pick one to see what changed.
revisions.explainCurrent: Compared with the current version: underlined text comes back if you restore this one, struck-through text goes.
revisions.explainPrevious: What this save changed: underlined text was added, struck-through text removed.
revisions.noPrevious: This is the oldest saved version; there is nothing before it to compare with.
revisions.same: This version is the same as the current one.
revisions.samePrevious: This save changed nothing in the title, excerpt or text.
revisions.empty: No saved versions yet. Every save adds one.
revisions.confirmDescription: Restoring this version replaces the edits you have not saved yet. The current saved version stays in the history.
revisions.undoUnavailable: Undo is not available: the item changed after the restore.
revisions.fieldsDiffer: Custom fields differ from the current version; restoring brings these back too.
revisions.fieldsChanged: This save also changed custom fields.
revisions.seoNote: SEO title and description are not kept in revisions: restoring leaves them as they are.

errors.date: Must be a date and time
errors.select: Must be one of the choices
errors.array: Must be a list of rows
errors.row: Must be a row of fields
errors.unknown: Not a field of this row
errors.numberComma: Use a point (.) for decimals, without thousands separators

fields.richUnsupported: This text holds content the editor cannot show. It is kept as stored.
fields.staleBefore: Not in the type any more:

fields.blocked: Not saved: check the highlighted fields.

seo.title: SEO title

seo.previewNoUrl: The address is known after the first save
